name: oh-my-bb
description: Independent BB plugins maintained by Hemanth Soni.

plugins.description: Keep coding when a Claude or ChatGPT account reaches its limit. Route Claude Code, Codex, omp, FX, nanocodex, and Pi through ordered accounts and optional API-key fallbacks. Translate Messages and Responses requests when a fallback uses another protocol. FX and nanocodex require their separate optional adapters. Claude Max accounts are restricted to Claude Code; API-key fallbacks bill per token. Optional Jev routing sends the truncated last user message and candidate model names to OpenRouter.
Publish versioned pages in project folders, browse them in BB, and share them securely. Chart support bundles Highcharts; users must obtain and manage their own Highcharts license.
